_comment: KAIROS sandbox runtime configuration. Edit this to change behavior without rebuilding.

tick._comment: 120s default in sandbox (slower for observability). Production uses 60s.

budget._comment: Real-use budget — each tick decision costs ~10¢ with full context. Old 100¢/hr cap was for sandbox safety but blocks active use. $5/hr is a sane upper bound for a personal agent — at peak usage that's $120/day, but typical idle ticks are much cheaper.

task._comment: Single concurrent task in sandbox for easier debugging.

models._comment: NON-claude OpenRouter ids — the runtime never invokes a claude model. These are record/label values; the actual per-call model comes from the KAIROS_*_MODEL env vars (tickModel/workModel/memoryModel/visionModel in index.ts).

dream._comment: Faster dreams in sandbox (5min vs 15min) so you can observe consolidation.
